scope: Test a derived rolling continuum branch against longer finite photon trains in the same optional 1D Hamiltonian. No physical scale calibration, matter-clock derivation, capture, gravitational response or observational validation.
interpretation: Agreement with an analytic branch is measured, not imposed as a pass criterion. Finite deterministic packets and startup transients are not a proof of continuum stability or cosmic stationarity. All source photons exist initially with total energy power times source_duration.
extension_reason: The preserved 32-duration run approached the predicted redshift and field-energy growth but its 24-30 in-flight energy-growth window differed about 17-18 percent from the rolling branch. Extend history and compare later energy and probe windows; preserve all prior evidence.
rate_window_method: Interpolate diagnostics to identical exact window endpoints on both grids; integrate the smooth flux histories and use energy derivatives for Hermite endpoint energies. Avoid changing a window with the adaptive solver step grid.
